title: Virgin Machine (KINO)
synopsis: Dorothee Müller, a naive young Hamburg journalist, has grown tired of her pushy lover Heinz. She shares an unfulfillable longing with her gay half-brother Bruno. In all innocence, she embarks on an investigation into romantic love — is it a disease that only afflicts women? From a pleasure-seeking hormone researcher's office to the chimpanzee enclosure at the zoo, her search yields no satisfying answers. So she leaves the old world behind, trading grey Hamburg for sunny San Francisco. Shot in striking black-and-white, Monika Treut's 1988 underground classic is a joyful, quietly radical journey into desire that remains as fresh and provocative as ever.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 漢堡記者桃樂絲厭倦了糾纏不清的戀人，決心以記者的專業精神，詰問浪漫愛情是否一種只折磨女性的疾病。她走訪荷爾蒙研究員的診所，觀察動物園黑猩猩的行為，卻始終找不到答案。於是她決定離開舊世界，隻身前往陽光普照的舊金山。在這座充滿生命力的城市，她遇上三位令人難忘的女性，徹底改變了她對愛與慾望的想像。莫妮卡楚特以俐落的黑白影像，拍出一部風趣而顛覆傳統的公路電影。時隔三十餘年，這部酷兒電影經典依然鮮活如初。
